svg.title: Pet Shiba
svg.desc: Groups (pivot in viewBox units, positive angle = clockwise): shiba root and body 42 75 for breathing, tail 28.6 50.3 (wag 0 to +8 deg), head 47.1 30.16 (tilt -6 to +5 deg) containing ear-right 54.3 9.4, head-base, ear-left 43.4 10.1 (each -8 to +8 deg), eye-left 50.2 15.4, eye-right 56.6 15.2, nose 57.6 19.5, mouth 54.6 23.4. Hidden swaps inside head: eyes-happy and eyes-sleepy replace eye-left and eye-right, mouth-open replaces mouth. Every pivot is also on its group as data-pivot.
